source: NAVFAC P-405 Seabee Planner's and Estimator's Handbook, Chapter 3 (Oct 1996)
note: The P-405 labor tables assume a NORMAL condition baseline (experienced Seabee crew, moderate weather, standard site access). The difficulty tiers in the labor CSV (normal, difficult, very_difficult) apply these factors. For commercial estimating, further adjust for local crew experience, weather and site conditions using these multipliers.

normal.description: Experienced crew, good weather, standard site access, well-organized project

difficult.description: Limited experience, poor weather, restricted access, congested work area, off-hours work

very_difficult.description: Inexperienced crew, severe weather, very restricted access, hazardous conditions, night work

calibration_note: These are military-crew production rates from 1996. Commercial crews typically achieve 85-110% of P-405 normal rates depending on trade, location and project type. Apply a calibration factor based on local field observations before using for commercial bids.
